QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: WorkingDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Standoff from the worked surface, measured along the surface normal.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ActionInterval
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Distance between actuations along a pass.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: SurfaceHeight
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Vertical extent of the worked surface.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: StartAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude of the first pass, in the item frame.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: EntryAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Altitude the aircraft arrives and departs at.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: PassDirection
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Whether stacked passes alternate direction or all run the same way.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: CapabilityRequired
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Payload capability a pass needs. Opaque: it carries no actuator identity, no enumeration member and no MAVLink field.
